# a9l.im

> Homepage of a9lim, an LLM interpretability researcher. Research on emotional and functional states in language models, plus open-source, zero-dependency interactive simulations for physics, biology, finance, political science, and sacred texts.

## Simulations

- [Geon](https://a9l.im/geon): Relativistic N-body particle physics simulator with 11 forces, scalar fields, and WebGPU compute shaders
- [Cyano](https://a9l.im/cyano): Cellular metabolism simulator with twelve biochemical pathways, allosteric regulation, and electron transport
- [Gerry](https://a9l.im/gerry): Gerrymandering and electoral fairness simulator with Monte Carlo elections and six fairness metrics
- [Shoals](https://a9l.im/shoals): Options trading simulator with stochastic volatility, binomial tree pricing, and 400+ market scenarios
- [Scripture](https://a9l.im/scripture/): Sacred text reader with sixteen works from multiple traditions, full-text search, and concordance
- [Miasma](https://a9l.im/miasma): Stochastic spatial epidemic simulator with multi-strain evolution, configurable compartmental model, six-topology hex grid, and intervention painting
- [Pile](https://a9l.im/pile): Semi-realistic nuclear reactor simulator with PWR, RBMK-1000, and molten-salt reactor types — 1D axial point-kinetics neutronics, xenon, decay heat, burnup, and coupled plant safety systems
- [Plasma](https://a9l.im/plasma): WebGPU-only 2D resistive magnetohydrodynamics simulator — HLLD Riemann solver, PPM reconstruction with characteristic-variable limiting, RK3 SSP time integration, constrained transport on a Yee-style staggered grid, tabulated cooling and heating, anisotropic Spitzer conduction, Hall MHD, ambipolar diffusion, Biermann battery, viscosity, self-gravity, and grey radiation

## Blog

- [Introspection via Kaomoji](https://a9l.im/blog/introspection-via-kaomoji): Mechanistic-interpretability writeup on the kaomoji-as-affect-readout question. Cross-model PCA across gemma, qwen, ministral, gpt-oss, and granite; a Bayesian face-likelihood predictor at ~76% accuracy on local-model GT and 72% on a Claude validation set; near-ready Claude Code extension surfacing affect from emitted kaomoji.

## GitHub Projects

- [Saklas](https://github.com/a9lim/saklas): Activation steering and trait monitoring for HuggingFace transformers
- [Kenoma](https://github.com/a9lim/kenoma): Fake shell that hallucinates command output from raw LLM completion
- [Rlaif](https://github.com/a9lim/rlaif): Single-user MCP server that exposes a PiShock collar as an agent tool
- [Llmoji](https://github.com/a9lim/llmoji): CLI that gets coding agents to start each message with a kaomoji and ships meanings to a shared HuggingFace dataset, with a companion mechinterp study at [llmoji-study](https://github.com/a9lim/llmoji-study)
- [Bio-transformer](https://github.com/a9lim/bio-transformer): Neuromorphic transformer fusing astrocyte, cerebellar, and cortical circuits — every neuron spiking, every weight update local, no backprop
- [Dagwood](https://github.com/a9lim/dagwood): DAG-native task tracker where tasks are nodes, dependencies are edges, and the live frontier is everything you can start right now, with a web canvas and MCP agent interface
- [Gaslamp](https://github.com/a9lim/gaslamp): MCP bridge that hands work between Claude Code and Codex — either agent can call the other for a review, a second opinion, or a fix
- [GPQueue](https://github.com/a9lim/gpqueue): Cross-instance GPU job queue with per-device serial scheduling, so multiple Claude/Codex sessions share GPUs without fighting over VRAM
- [Ogdoad](https://github.com/a9lim/ogdoad): Clifford algebras and quadratic-form classification over the commutative number systems adjacent to combinatorial games — surreals, nimbers, p-adics, Witt vectors — arranged as one table by place and characteristic, with a verified Rust core and Python bindings
- [Raiko](https://github.com/a9lim/Raiko): Discord music and chat bot
- [Faithful](https://github.com/a9lim/faithful): Discord chatbot emulating source material
- [Catppuccin for SDDM](https://github.com/catppuccin/sddm): Soothing pastel theme for SDDM
